criteria.reason: The keyboard row renders Copy Last, Next, and Done.
Done now shares the row instead of taking the full width.
The buttons’ 14px vertical padding plus text height provides at least a 44px target.
Copy Last updates the set data, but does not update the keypad’s displayed field value.
Next opens the reps keypad when invoked from the weight keypad.
The styles use design tokens for some colors and the radius, but also hardcode white.
The actions use a flexible row layout that can fit on mobile.
Button labels contain no exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all existing tests passing.
The new test checks that the Copy Last handler is called, but does not test copying the previous set’s value.
